item.title: NTPC Adds 360 MW of Solar Capacity in Gujarat, Rajasthan
item.description: NTPC said it has declared commercial operation of 359.58 megawatts (MW) of solar capacity across projects in Gujarat and Rajasthan, lifting the group’s total commercial capacity to more than 85.5 gigawatts (GW). The state-owned power producer said it has achieved commercial operation of 243.66 MW from its 1,255 MW Khavda-I solar photovoltaic project in Gujarat, developed by NTPC Renewable Energy Ltd, a step-down subsidiary through NTPC Green Energy Ltd (NGEL). item.title: HiTHIUM’s ∞Power8 Ushers in 8-Hour Era of Long-Duration Battery Storage
item.description: HiTHIUM unveiled the ∞Power8 6.9MW/55.2MWh at its third Eco-Day event, the world’s first 8-hour-native battery energy storage solution. Built on a dedicated long-duration energy storage (LDES) system architecture, the innovation integrates a specialised 8-hour battery cell, designed natively from cell to system. item.title: Green Stocks Dec 19: Renewable Firms Ride High On Favourable Market Condition
item.description: On the last trading day of the week, Indian equity markets moved higher, supported by favourable global cues. With benchmark indices Nifty and Sensex posting gains, renewable energy stocks also traded higher, with most Indian green energy companies recording an uptick. Leading Indian solar module manufacturers Waaree Energies and Emmvee Photovoltaics posted the sharpest gains, with their shares rising by nearly 6%. item.title: SPIE and Tesla Strengthen European Partnership for Battery Energy Storage Projects
item.description: European multi-technical services company SPIE has announced the signing of a European framework agreement with Tesla for the implementation of battery energy storage system (BESS) projects. The agreement, which is renewable every three years, applies to all SPIE subsidiaries across Europe with expertise in BESS installation. item.title: Emmvee Arm Commissions Sixth 2.5 GW Solar Module Line in Bengaluru, Lifts Capacity to 10.3 GW
item.description: Karnataka-based Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Limited, through its subsidiary Emmvee Energy Private Limited (EEPL), has commenced operations of its 2.5 GW solar module line at Unit VI. In a regulatory filing, Emmvee said the latest unit was commissioned at its factory in Sulibele, Hoskote Taluk, Bengaluru, Karnataka, on December 20, 2025. item.title: What Is Peculiar in MNRE’s Revised Solar Module Testing Norms
item.description: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) has issued revised guidelines for series approval of solar modules for conducting testing in test laboratories. item.title: Waaree Solar Americas to Invest USD 30 Million in USH
item.description: Waaree Solar Americas, the US subsidiary of Waaree Energies, has signed a binding term sheet to invest around USD 30 million in United Solar Holding Inc. (USH) by subscribing to Series B preferred shares, as it deepens efforts to secure a long-term polysilicon supply chain for its global manufacturing expansion.
